slides.texte_overlay:
10/10 uncomfortable things
to do alone
(but it gets easier)

1. go to the cinema alone.
pick your film, your seat.
no one to ask "did you like it?"

2. have dinner alone
in a restaurant.
no phone. look around, listen.

3. raise your hand and say
"i don't agree".
calmly. once is enough
for it to feel natural.

4. explore a city alone
for a day.
walk at your own pace,
stop wherever you want.

5. go to a free talk.
library, museum, university.
and sit in the front row.

6. take a walk with no music,
no headphones.
just you and your thoughts.

7. ask for help when you
don't understand.
people love explaining
what they know.

8. learn something new every
night, just for you.
a story about art, a moment
in history. no grades.
